message: No detected input validation: The code only checks for the existence of a 'good' subdirectory and calls exit() if missing, but performs no schema, dtype, value-range, or structural validation on the loaded images or dataset contents.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local filesystem path (dataset_path = 'dummy_dataset') with no remote fetching, so no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks are implemented or needed.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only checks that a 'good' subdirectory exists and sorts class labels by directory name, with no comparison of label distributions, validation against an expected label set, or label-noise detection.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples during data preparation; images are loaded and transformed directly without any poisoning defense.

No detected model integrity verification: The code instantiates models (MaskDifferNet, DifferNet) from scratch and does not load any pretrained weights or serialized model files, so there is no integrity verification mechanism present.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads datasets and creates dataloaders but performs no class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is standard torch.optim.Adam with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: The code uses a separate validate set and computes AUROC, but there is no held-out test set isolated from model selection, no signed/hashed evaluation data, and no multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code passes data directly from dataloaders to the model via preprocess_batch() without any shape, range, or schema validation checks on the incoming inputs.

No detected output bounds checks: The inference/evaluation path computes anomaly scores and AUROC but does not include NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold validation on model outputs before returning them.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision anomaly detection model (normalizing flows on images), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
